I am renting this small piece of land here near Dar es Salaam, only about a quarter hectare, so I must be careful with every shilling I spend. Since the plot is not mine, I do not want to invest too heavily in things like expensive fertilizer, but I will put some manure from the neighborhood to keep the soil alive. I will buy a small amount of urea to boost the crop, use improved seed because it gives better harvest in this town area, and spray a little pesticide since pests are bad near the city. Water is a problem and I cannot afford irrigation equipment, so I will depend on the rains and work the plot mostly with my wife and myself, hiring one or two people only for land preparation.
